Verify pass too. Build green, task done.

Root cause: `resolveRelease` in `packages/shared/config.js` used shallow `Object.assign`, so any override touching `output` or `sourcemap` wiped the rest of that nested object (e.g. `@acme/api`'s `output:{format:'esm'}` dropped `dir`). Fixed by deep-merging those two nested keys across defaults/overrides/CLI layers.
